entries.conditions: ADD of a large baked-constant positional embedding ([1,677,384]) onto patch tokens miscomputes with BUILD-DEPENDENT severity: backbone corr 0.55-0.99 across otherwise-identical builds of the same model. Same baked-constant execution fault as the FULLY_CONNECTED row.

evidence.source_model: RF-DETR-Seg-Nano per-layer device taps across builds

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: backbone corr >=0.9995 vs patched torch, stable across builds
rewrite_hints.rewrite: host-feed the embedding as a runtime input (cls token + pos pre-added on the host, patch pos-embed as a second input)
rewrite_hints.symptom: ViT backbone accuracy varies per build (corr 0.55-0.99) with no error and no code change

entries.conditions: Rank-3 batched matmuls silently miscompute in transformer attention context (stock nn.MultiheadAttention lowers to them; the tent-matmul grid-sample BMM hits the same fault at rank 3); rank-4 equivalents of the same math are exact. Re-confirmed in the RF-DETR-Seg-Nano hunt (earlier witnesses on 2.1.3/2.1.5).

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: attention exact; source model fully delegated (1293/1293 + 884/884 nodes, 1 partition each)
rewrite_hints.rewrite: keep every batched matmul rank-4 (manual head-split attention; reshape rank-3 BMMs to [B,1,M,N])
rewrite_hints.symptom: attention outputs silently wrong on device, desktop exact

entries.conditions: A compute chain consuming a LARGE BAKED-CONSTANT tensor executes incorrectly while the identical ops with the tensor fed as a runtime input are exact. Minimal pair: tgt + FFN(tgt) with tgt a baked [1,100,256] weight -> device corr 0.966; same graph with tgt as an input -> 0.99999. fp32 and fp16 flatbuffers return IDENTICAL wrong numbers (not precision), and severity is compilation-context dependent (a subgraph can probe clean in isolation and break in the full build). Unchanged with the 2.2.0 GPU .so pair on the same harness.

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: chain exact (corr 0.99999 on the minimal pair); source model ships 100% GPU, real-image box IoU >=0.99 / mask IoU >=0.995 vs PyTorch
rewrite_hints.rewrite: feed the constant as a runtime graph input (host-supplied .bin) or fold it into adjacent layer weights (exact)
rewrite_hints.symptom: silently wrong outputs downstream of a large baked constant (decoder hidden states corr 0.97 on the source model, no error)

entries.conditions: Broadcast-constant MUL feeding a residual ADD (LayerScale h + lambda*f(h), lambda a baked [384] per-channel constant) miscomputes: device corr 0.62, vs 0.9999 for the identical block computed as h + f(h). Same baked-constant execution fault as the FULLY_CONNECTED row.

rewrite_hints.rewrite: fold the per-channel constant into the preceding Linear's weight rows and bias (exact) and drop the MUL
rewrite_hints.symptom: ViT blocks with LayerScale silently wrong on device (corr 0.62), desktop exact
